verdict.rationale: uv has strong documented CI support: the official `astral-sh/setup-uv` GitHub Action installs uv, adds it to PATH, and optionally persists the cache across CI runs (uv-docs-10/34/46), plus first-party caching docs explain aggressive caching, cache keys, and cache-clean commands (uv-docs-25, uv-docs-26/45, uv-docs-11/49). Community feedback corroborates real speed gains in practice (uv-comm-1, uv-comm-2, uv-comm-15) though also notes some cache/redownload quirks (uv-comm-4, uv-comm-11). However, explicit documentation of 'offline-capable installs' (e.g., an --offline flag or fully airgapped install workflow) is not present in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit offline/airgapped install documentation, independent CI benchmark data confirming cache-restore speedups.
